subject.title: fix(agents): xAI/Grok requests fail after a stale reasoning replay ("could not decrypt encrypted_content")

question: Should maintainers accept pre-fix production logs plus deterministic positive/negative unit coverage as sufficient proof for this non-inducible xAI/Grok code-less decrypt error?
rationale: ClawSweeper cannot mark after-fix real behavior proof sufficient because the changed behavior has not been shown in a real Grok gateway run, but the contributor plausibly explains that the exact provider-rotation trigger cannot be induced on demand.

options.title: Accept a proof override
options.body: Treat the production logs, dependency-backed error shape, and focused retry tests as enough for this narrow predicate fix, then rely on normal CI/rebase gates before merge.

options.title: Wait for organic xAI proof
options.body: Keep the PR blocked until a future real xAI/Grok rotation produces redacted after-fix gateway logs showing the retry succeeds.

options.title: Close or replace the PR
options.body: If the proof bar cannot be relaxed and organic proof is impractical, close this branch or replace it with a maintainer-authored fix under explicit proof ownership.

recommendation.title: Accept a proof override
recommendation.body: Treat the production logs, dependency-backed error shape, and focused retry tests as enough for this narrow predicate fix, then rely on normal CI/rebase gates before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The prior merged retry work and current OpenAI Responses retry boundary make steipete the best available owner for the proof-sufficiency decision.
